parts.name: MG996R metal-gear servo
parts.notes: search: MG996R servo 4 pack. 25T spline, 4.8-7.2 V; run at 5 V here.

parts.name: 25T aluminium servo horn arm, M3 holes 12/16/20 mm
parts.notes: 4-pack. The link pins in the 20 mm hole (M3 threaded).

parts.name: M3 aluminium rod end + ball stud
parts.notes: search: M3 aluminum tie rod end ball joint with ball stud (RC 1/10). Snap-on ball socket, M3 female thread.

parts.name: M3x12 set screw (grub screw)
parts.notes: search: M3x12 set screw. Joins each rod end to its printed link; thread-locker on the link side. Gives +-2 mm length trim.

parts.name: 8in 4-wire resistive touch panel 183x141
parts.notes: NJYTouch 8" 4:3, 183 x 141 mm, view area 164 x 124, 4-pin FPC tail, activation < 80 g.

parts.name: Adafruit TSC2007 I2C resistive touch controller (STEMMA QT)
parts.notes: Not sold on Amazon. 1 mm FPC socket takes the panel tail with no soldering; reads X, Y and pressure.

parts.name: STEMMA QT / Qwiic to male Dupont cable, 300 mm
parts.notes: search: Qwiic JST SH 4 pin to male dupont 300mm. TSC2007 under the plate to the ESP32 terminals; slack for tilt.

parts.name: ESP32 screw-terminal breakout (38 pin)
parts.notes: search: ESP32 38 pin screw terminal breakout DevKitC. Must match the DevKitC's 25.4 mm row spacing. Stuck down with foam tape.

parts.name: PCA9685 16-channel servo driver
parts.notes: search: PCA9685 servo driver pre-soldered headers. Servo plugs go straight on; V+ screw terminal for 5 V.

parts.name: 1000uF 16V electrolytic capacitor
parts.notes: search: 1000uF 16V capacitor. Clamped in the PCA9685 V+/GND terminal with the supply wires.

parts.name: 5V 5A power adapter (UL), 5.5x2.1
parts.notes: search: 5V 5A power supply 5.5x2.1 UL listed. 3 servos ~3 A typical peaks + ESP32 0.3 A.

parts.name: DC jack, panel mount, pre-wired
parts.notes: search: 5.5x2.1 panel mount DC jack with wire leads. 11 mm hole in the base shell.

parts.name: Inline fuse holder 5A
parts.notes: search: inline mini blade fuse holder 18AWG with 5A fuse.

parts.name: Wago 221-413 (5V)
parts.notes: search: Wago 221-413. 5 V rail.

parts.notes: search: Wago 221-413. Ground rail.

parts.name: Wago 221-412 (fuse)
parts.notes: search: Wago 221-412. Jack + to fuse holder.

parts.name: 18 AWG silicone wire, red + black
parts.notes: search: 18 AWG silicone wire red black. Four 12 cm pieces, ends stripped 11 mm (Wago strip gauge).

parts.name: Dupont jumper wires, female-male
parts.notes: search: dupont jumper wires female to male 20cm. PCA9685 logic header to the ESP32 terminals (4 used).

parts.name: Rubber feet
parts.notes: search: 1/2 inch self adhesive rubber bumpers 5mm. 3 used.

parts.name: Double-sided foam tape (VHB)
parts.notes: search: 3M VHB tape 1 inch. Panel to plate, boards to the bottom disc.

parts.name: Ping-pong ball
parts.notes: search: 40mm ping pong balls 6 pack. 2.7 g: probably too light to register on a resistive panel.

parts.name: Steel ball 1-1/4in
parts.notes: search: 1-1/4 inch chrome steel ball. 131 g, well over the panel's 80 g activation force: the ball that reliably works.
